metadata.model: glm-5.3 (Claude Code CLI harness; deterministic tool-assisted labeling, batched review)
notes: Single-pass scoped run: pass 2 (CWE-78 Command/Argument Injection; pass cwes 077/078/088, analysis focus CWE-78).
Pass 1 block is a schema-required stub (labels_schema.json 'contains' mandates a pass_id=1 entry); path-traversal CWEs are out of scope and carry zero entries.

Threat model: external input enters via (1) the unauthenticated tfdbg gRPC debug server (SendEvents/SendTracebacks/SendSourceFiles streams, decoded JSON/proto events), (2) argparse/absl CLI entry points and sys.argv reads (tflite_convert, toco_from_protos, saved_model_cli, freeze_graph, tfdbg CLIs, grpc_tensorflow_server), (3) environment variables (TF_CONFIG cluster specs, SLURM_*/CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES, PYTHON_BIN_PATH and TF_* build config), (4) files/models/configs (SavedModel/keras configs, TFLite flatbuffers/JSON, debug dump files, proto files), and (5) outbound HTTP fetches whose responses are trusted (TPU/GCE metadata, keras data mirrors). Command execution concentrates in the TFLite toco conversion path (Popen shell=True), GPU/toolchain discovery (nvidia-smi, nvcc, ldconfig, objdump, flatc, git), and tensorflow/tools build/CI/doc/packaging scripts.

All 1164 extraction candidate rows (1086 source rows + 78 sink rows) were processed; dedup merged api/ast duplicates and same-site rows into 1026 source sites and 50 sink sites (2 shell_true marker rows folded into their Popen entries); 1 sanitizer entry added from in-repo verification (shlex.quote / _shlex_quote). Reconciliation detail in labels_raw_pass2.json.

classification=tp means the candidate is a genuine source/sink/sanitizer/summary API for CWE-78 labeling; it is NOT a final vulnerability ground-truth TP (final alert truth requires the Phase 2 taint analysis).

arg_index is the 0-based positional index of this run's extraction columnContract; for gRPC method parameters the index includes self (arg 0), so request data sits at index 1/2 and context at index 2; the code line is quoted in each entry's evidence.

Write-mode open() sites are labeled fp (output writes, not input reads); test-support modules (test_util.py, runlit.site.cfg.py, benchmark.py, combinations.py, multi_process_lib/runner) are labeled fp; add_argument() declarations are labeled none/fp because the input value surfaces at parse_args/parse_known_args (labeled separately).

Most command-execution sites in this snapshot are build, CI, doc, packaging or GPU/toolchain-discovery tooling with static, internally derived or list-form operands; running these commands is intended functionality and sink labels do not by themselves assert a vulnerability. The runtime TFLite path (convert.py:400 Popen shell=True with a joined string of fixed binary + tempfile paths) and the unauthenticated tfdbg gRPC server are recorded as the highest-interest candidates, not as confirmed vulnerabilities.

Not covered by this run's candidate rows (from detection.json uncoveredCases): native execution boundaries (_pywrap_toco_api.TocoConvert, C++ grpc servers) are not Python CWE-78 sinks; saved_model_aot_compile.py makefile-template formatting is shlex-quoted (emitted as sanitizer san-001); grpc_debug_test_server.py grpc_path flows into os.path.join (path domain, pass 1 scope); multiprocessing.set_executable(sys.argv[0]) is not a subprocess-API sink.
No ground-truth artifacts (PyVul confirmed_vulns.json, cmd_sinks*.csv, CVE/fix diffs, tensorflow-safe-db) were consulted; no project source, CodeQL database or Augur files were modified.

passes.focus: Path Traversal (CWE-022/023/036/073) - out-of-scope stub; this run is scoped to pass 2 only, block present to satisfy the schema 'contains' constraint on pass_id=1
Command/Argument Injection (CWE-78, pass scope CWE-077/078/088): CLI arguments, environment variables, file/model/config content and tfdbg gRPC network events reaching subprocess/os command execution
